CREATE MASTER KEY;

--手动创建完整外部表
-- 1、创建数据库范围凭据
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL WorkspaceIdentity
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

-- 2、创建外部数据源（基于已链接的存储账户）

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ods_external_source
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://ods@sahyivy.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = WorkspaceIdentity
);

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE tds_external_source
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://tds@sahyivy.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = WorkspaceIdentity
);


-- 3、创建外部文件格式
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);

-- 4、创建外部表
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ods_order_info (
    id                     BIGINT,
    consignee              VARCHAR(100),
    consignee_tel          VARCHAR(20),
    total_amount           DECIMAL(10,2),
    order_status           VARCHAR(20),
    user_id                BIGINT,
    payment_way            VARCHAR(20),
    delivery_address       VARCHAR(1000),
    order_comment          VARCHAR(200),
    out_trade_no           VARCHAR(50),
    trade_body             VARCHAR(200),
    create_time            DATETIME2,
    operate_time           DATETIME2,
    expire_time            DATETIME2,
    process_status         VARCHAR(20),
    tracking_no            VARCHAR(100),
    parent_order_id        BIGINT,
    img_url                VARCHAR(200),
    province_id            INT,
    activity_reduce_amount DECIMAL(16,2),
    coupon_reduce_amount   DECIMAL(16,2),
    original_total_amount  DECIMAL(16,2),
    feight_fee             DECIMAL(16,2),
    feight_fee_reduce      DECIMAL(16,2),
    refundable_time        DATETIME2--,
    --CONSTRAINT PK_ods_order_info PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (id) NOT ENFORCED  -- 定义主键
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_order_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

--主键，想做动态MERGE
CONSTRAINT PK_YourTable PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (id, region_id) NOT ENFORCED  -- 定义组合主键

ALTER TABLE ods_order_info ADD CONSTRAINT PK_ods_order_info PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (id) NOT ENFORCED;

ALTER TABLE tds_order_info ADD CONSTRAINT PK_tds_order_info PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (id) NOT ENFORCED;

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv_format
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',      -- 指定列之间的分隔符
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',      -- 指定字符串字段的引号字符
        FIRST_ROW = 2,               -- 从第二行开始读取（跳过标题行）
        USE_TYPE_DEFAULT = TRUE,     -- 对于缺失值使用数据类型的默认值
        ENCODING = 'UTF8'            -- 指定文件编码为UTF-8[1,3](@ref)
          )
);
